# Coding Conventions

## Python

- Follow PEP 8
- Use type hints
- Write docstrings for all functions

## Testing

- Use pytest
- Aim for 80% coverage

# Project Standards

## Code Review

- All PRs need approval
- Run linters before committing

## Documentation

- Update README for new features
